headline_changes: Python 3.11 is now required across all packages. This release adds a Conversation object for carrying state between runs, unified cross-provider prompt caching, and hosted Postgres stores for messages and media. Durable execution now records more tool calls, while fixes improve recovery after interrupted runs and prevent repeated writes.

Fixes prevent updates to older checkpoints from affecting other branches and avoid replaying abandoned branches into DeltaChannel forks. DeltaChannel counters are preserved across update_state paths, subgraph delta channels use the caller-resolved saver, and get_state no longer reports answered interrupts.

Page sync now streams progress, supports cancellation, and reports failed page paths and causes. Workflow steps can emit progress events through AgentOS streaming. Fixes improve retries for transient page-fetch failures and prevent incomplete syncs on Mintlify-style sites from leaving removed pages searchable.

OpenAI live sessions can reconnect after a drop, and GPT-Live now supports WebSearchTool. Compatibility changes include ending runs on unexpected BackgroundTools exceptions and disabling RepoContext inventory by default. Fixes improve run-state recovery after cancellation or Ctrl-C and prevent BubblewrapWorkspace commands from executing code on the SSH host.

Adds AgentOS role-based access control, a database-backed filesystem with file routes, and AIMLAPITools for image, video, speech and transcription. Breaking changes: existing DbFileSystem tables require a manual migration to the new key, and MCP default and lifecycle tools are now opt-in. Notable fixes address duplicated paused runs during HITL continuation and recovery when a chained OpenAI response is gone.
Release tests and readiness checks were fixed without changing SDK runtime behavior. Default integration and automatic example runs now skip external-provider cases unless explicitly opted in.

Fixed a high-severity concurrency-limiter issue that could block requests after streamed requests, with changes to limiter-sharing and custom-limiter behavior. Added ToolCallJudge to assess tool calls before execution and AskUser support for deferring questions to the host. Deprecated pydantic_ai_harness.step_persistence.naming.
Added `response_schema` support to `interrupt()`. Fixed typing for undeclared v3 stream projections and changed subgraph detection to use bytecode instead of source.

Web search tools now support image results, MCP tools can use server-wide guardrails, and Unix-local sandbox environment isolation is configurable. Notable fixes improve recovery of resumed session writes, preserve concurrent writes during compaction, and redact speech prompts and instructions from traces.

Added support for newer Claude and GPT models, multimodal AG-UI input, async LLM reranking, and MCP 2.x. Notable fixes preserve chat history and ingestion nodes, correct property-graph search behavior, and prevent HWP decompression from exceeding bounds.
Added support for exposing trace_policy on add_node. Fixed delta channel history to collect writes at a plain-value seed.

Adds a `crewai eval` command to identify where a stopped model broke and uses the LiteLLM catalog for context windows. Fixes flows resuming after human feedback, deployment failures and ZIP updates, and streamed Anthropic tool-call completion events.

ClaudeAgent and CodexAgent gain durable sessions, background runs with cancellation, retries, metrics, structured output, attachments, and stored event replay; ClaudeAgent also gains checkpoint-based step replay. External-agent turns now allow only one in-flight run per session, returning HTTP 409 for concurrent turns. Fixes improve attachment staging safety and reject malformed media input with HTTP 422 before dispatch.

Fixes align conditional approvals with validated tool arguments and deliver tool-not-found output when server-managed sessions resume. Other fixes address concurrent SQLite startup, Windows-host sandbox paths, and subprocess cleanup when streams close early. Vulnerable dependencies were updated without changing SDK APIs.

Core removes the deprecated ipex-llm and optimum-intel IPEX integrations, adds native async support to StructuredLLMRerank, and fixes streaming and failed function-tool retries. The release also addresses security alerts across many packages.

NVIDIA embeddings gained HTTP client support. Core fixes address invalid node IDs in DocumentSummaryIndex deletion, structured-output failures, UTF-8 persistence encoding, and message-block buffer resolution.
Fixed rwlock ownership retention when acquisition is interrupted, corrected task output display in log-tasks-outputs, and preserved source URLs on the documentation site.
No release notes published

Added XPU support for OpenCLIP and DeepInfra as an OpenAI-compatible provider. Evaluation runs now record why they stopped and track per-run cost and time. Fixes address unsupported stop sequences sent to certain OpenAI models, GitHub loader source attribution, and SQLite flow initialization contention.
No release notes published

Core adds multimodal synthesis and fixes cache writes from multiprocessing workers in IngestionPipeline. Other fixes address memory token counting for DocumentBlock and context propagation in FunctionTool.

Fixed a moderate local web_fetch denial-of-service issue caused by deeply nested attacker-controlled HTML. Added a unified workspace API for harness tools across local and sandbox environments, including new sandbox options. Compatibility changes include new Anthropic max_tokens defaults and SubAgents no longer loading agent files by default.
Added support for current image-generation tool options. Fixed UnixLocal file API symlink races in the sandbox and reset the compaction response chain after a session pop.

Fixes improve DeltaChannel checkpointing and replay, including message IDs and handling of failed writes. Cached-node writes are now saved like executed-node writes, interrupt breakpoints are respected during drains, and astream_events no longer drops control or interrupt events.

Knowledge search now supports a shared retrieval pipeline with MMR and recency rerankers; vector-database-level rerankers are deprecated. New capabilities include guarded documentation-source relocation, typed page-tool results, Y-API support, and machine-readable cancellation stages. Notable fixes address async tool hooks, paginated MCP tool discovery, and WebSocket workflow submissions.

Added conversation compaction for long sessions, a Codex external-agent adapter, and HyDE-based retrieval. AgentOS gained a shared browser-origin policy, while follow-up suggestions became configurable. Notable fixes address repeated tool approvals, response-cache schema collisions, and failed JsonDb writes.

Adds configurable MCP listing page limits, opt-in Docker removal protection, configurable memory consolidation turns, and an opt-in encrypted history scan budget. Fixes include isolating nested agent tool state, preserving guarded outputs and diagnostics, redacting tool failure details and streaming exception tracebacks, and rejecting silently discarded tool arguments.

Added agent-run evaluation briefs, model and role swapping, Oracle integrations, and experimental job lifecycle and runner support. Fixes include allowing start steps to re-run on listened-for events and making evaluation exit with code 1 unless its gate passes.
Core adds multimodal synthesis and query engines, plus a mock LLM for tool calling. Fixes address video and document block handling, workflow state leaking across runs, and splitter recursion errors.

BrowserUse now runs on the host model by default, and browser-use telemetry is opt-in. New capabilities include layered Skills libraries, PostgreSQL-backed task durability, Render Workflows integration, and a local microVM sandbox. Fixes address authentication and client ownership for custom MCP HTTP clients, harness context overcounting, and repeated compaction duplicating summaries and prompts.
